# ARWP Search + Agent Recommendations

> Dated, source-backed implementation guidance for keeping public websites discoverable, citable, fresh and agent-operable across classic search, generative search and browser-agent ecosystems.

This surface is non-normative implementation guidance. It does not promise crawling, indexing, ranking, citation or agent success and does not collapse evidence into a readiness score.

## Start here

- [Human guide](https://dkharlanau.github.io/agent-ready-web-profile/recommendations/): Current Search + Agent recommendations and status model.
- [Machine-readable ruleset](https://dkharlanau.github.io/agent-ready-web-profile/recommendations/registry.json): Current dated rules, priorities, upstream status, testability and primary sources.
- [Ruleset history](https://dkharlanau.github.io/agent-ready-web-profile/recommendations/history/index.json): Immutable historical snapshots; prior recommendations are not silently rewritten.
- [Implementation guide](https://dkharlanau.github.io/agent-ready-web-profile/SEARCH-AGENT-RECOMMENDATIONS.md): Audit, freshness, visibility and runtime-evidence workflow.
- [Product strategy](https://dkharlanau.github.io/agent-ready-web-profile/SEARCH-AGENT-STRATEGY.md): Why ARWP resolves upstream mechanisms instead of inventing another universal manifest.

## Current ruleset

Ruleset: `2026.09`
Reviewed: `2026-09-05`

Current layers:

- classic search technical eligibility;
- generative-search eligibility and platform opportunities;
- citation/deep-link addressability;
- freshness and change notification;
- browser-agent runtime evidence;
- owner-observed AI visibility measurement;
- emerging-governance watch items.

Notable 2026.09 items include Google Preferred Sources, Read more deep-link guidance, accurate sitemap `lastmod`, OAI-SearchBot access separation, IndexNow, Google/Bing AI visibility measurement, WebMCP runtime/evals, draft IETF AIPREF `Content-Usage`, and W3C Introduction Layer incubation.

## Evidence semantics

- `pass` / `fail`: directly observable checks with bounded evidence.
- `warn`: heuristic issue or optional opportunity worth review.
- `observed`: an experimental/draft signal was actually present.
- `not-assessed`: requires manual judgment, authenticated owner data or browser runtime evidence.
- `not-applicable`: the optional mechanism is not adopted or does not apply.
- `watch`: upstream work is still in incubation.

Static metadata is never upgraded into browser/protocol runtime conformance. Authenticated Google/Bing metrics are never inferred from public crawling. A successful IndexNow receipt is not proof of indexing. Experimental standards remain labelled experimental.

## CLI

```text
arwp audit https://example.com
arwp audit https://example.com --json
arwp-visibility compare before.json after.json
arwp-agent-eval show agent-eval.json
arwp-indexnow payload https://example.com --urls-file=changed-urls.txt
```

## Maintenance

The repository runs a scheduled upstream source watcher. Reachability is only a maintenance signal; material source changes require review before the ruleset changes. New rulesets create a new frozen history snapshot.
